intro.text: The chief surgeon in Amaram's army.

items.text: During Amaram's battles, Ven ran the pavilion where surgery was done and trained apprentice surgeons, many of them soldiers injured in battle. Kaladin bribed him so that the men of his squad would be the first darkeyes treated.

appearance.text: A tall man with a long face and a bulbous nose, who wears a loose white robe.
